description_en: Vagalāmukhī, located in the Kumbheśvara Temple Complex, is an important Śākta Pīṭḥa (abode of the Tantric Goddess) in Lalitpur. According to the tantric traditions, Vagalāmukhī is one of the Ten Mahāvidyās (Daśamahāvidyā) and the master of Bṛhaspati. For this reason, devotees visit this shrine on Thursdays to alleviate the detrimental astrological misfortune. It is believed that Vagalāmukhī fulfils one’s wishes and perishes his or her enemies if she is worshipped on Thursdays. Yellow flowers, pieces of yellow cloth, sandalwood, gold, and barley are used to worship her. If the family members of a deceased cannot carry out the funerary rites or if someone fails to worship his or her clan deity on the specified day and time, they go to worship Vagalāmukhī and ask her for forgiveness. She is invoked and sought patronage of astrological misfortunes.Vagalāmukhī Mandira has a two-storey structure, facing north. Its roof was previously tiled withjhĩgaṭī, but it was replaced with copper sheets in 1982 CE (VS 2038). There are three pinnacles (gajū) on top of the roof, which were gilded during the temple’s restoration in 1997 CE (VS 2054). A metaltoraṇa(on which an image of Bhagavatī in the middle and Gaṇeśa and Kumāra to her right and left, are respectively carved) crowns the main entrance to the temple. Vagalāmukhī is consecrated in the main sanctum (garbhagṛha) on the first floor. There is no statue of her and she is represented by a small streaming puddle. A small shrine is established around Vagalāmukhī. The shrine’s pinnacle, roof,toraṇa,and pillars are all wrapped with silver. A canopy of seven snakes (nāga) is kept atop thegajūas a parasol.A metalmaṇḍala,representing Ānandā Bhairava, is installed in front of the deity. Rows of aniconic stones are placed in the sanctum, representing the Ten Mahāvidyās. In addition to that, there are also two aniconic statues of Bhīmasena inside the sanctum.There is no documented evidence regarding to the initial construction of this temple. Previously, the deity was consecrated in open-air as there was no temple to house her. Before the present temple was built, Lakṣmī Nakarmī offered a copper moon and a pair of lions to the deity in 1895 CE (NS 1015). In 1898 CE (NS 1018), Baktabārasĩ offered a brass flag. Later, Vyaṣārāja and Kularāja jointly offered a lion pillar to her in 1930 CE (NS 1050). In 1931 CE (VS 1988), Prime Minister Bhīma Śamśera constructed the present-day temple. It caught on fire in 2009 CE (VS 2065) due to an electric short-circuit, and was renovated with the generous donations of the local community.A Karmācārya caste member used to carry out the daily rituals of the temple, however, presentl, a Rajopādhyāya priest performs the rituals. The Jigī (Kapālī) caste members take care of the temple. Every year on the last Saturday of the month of Maṅsīra, a sacrifice of buffalo, sheep, goat, duck, and fish (pañcabali) is offered to Vagalāmukhī.
description_ne: ललितपुर जिल्लाको महत्त्वपूर्ण शक्तिपीठमध्ये वगलामुखी पनि एक हो । कुम्भेश्वर मन्दिर परिसरभित्र कुम्भेश्वर मन्दिरको दक्षिणतर्फ वगलामुखीको मन्दिर रहेको छ। तन्त्रशास्त्र अनुसारका दशमहाविद्यामध्ये वगलामुखी पनि एक हो । वगलामुखीलाई वृहस्पतिको स्वामी मानिने हुनाले ग्रह पीडाबाट मुक्ति पाउने उद्देश्यले विहिबार दर्शन गर्ने गरिन्छ । विहिबार विशेष भीड हुने वगलामुखीको दर्शन गरी पूजा गरेमा शत्रु नाश हुने, मनोकांक्षा सिद्ध हुने विश्वास गरिन्छ । देवीको उपासना गर्दा पँहेलो फूल, पँहेलो कपडा, पँहेलो चन्दन सुन, जौ आदिको प्रयोग गरिन्छ । विशेष कारणले कुनै व्यक्तिले कुलपूजा एवं पितृकार्यहरू सम्पादन गर्न सकेनन् भने वगलामुखीको आराधना गरिन्छ । पितृ र कुललाई सञ्चालन गर्ने वृहस्पति हुन् र वगलामुखी माता वृहस्पतिको स्वामी भएको हुँदा कुलदोष एवं पितृ दोषहरू लाग्दा वगलामुखीको शरणमा जाने परम्परा रहिआएको छ ।वगलामुखीको मन्दिर उत्तराभिमुख गरी दुई तलाको बनाइएको छ । छानामा पहिले झिंगटी राखिएको भएपनि विसं २०३८ (सन् १९८२) मा तामाको छाना हालिएको थियो । छानामा सुनको मोलम्बा लगाइएको तीनवटा गजूर राखिएका छन् । विसं २०५४ (सन् १९९७) मा मन्दिरको जीर्णोद्धार गरिँदा गजूरमा सुनको मोलम्बा लगाइएको थियो । मन्दिरको भुइँतलामा गर्भगृह बनाई वगलामुखी स्थापना गरिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र प्रवेश गर्ने ढोकामाथि बीचमा भगवती र दायाँबाायँ गणेश र कुमार अंकित धातुको तोरण राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र वगलामुखीको कुनै मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छैन, बरु निरन्तर पानीले भरिरहने सानो खाल्डोलाई वगलामुखी मानी पूजा गरिन्छ । वगलामुखीलाई चाँदीको सानो मन्दिर बनाएर चाँदीको पाताले मोडी चाँदीकै गजूर, छाना, तोरण, खम्बा बनाइएको छ । सातवटा सर्पफणाले गजूरमाथि छत्रको काम गरेको छ । मन्दिरको दुबैतिर सर्पको बटारिएको शरीर कलात्मक छ । वगलामुखीको अगाडि आनन्द भैरवको प्रतीकस्वरूप धातुको मण्डल बनाइएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र दशमहाविद्याको प्रतीक स्वरूप आकृतिविहीन ढुंगाहरू र दुईवटा भीमसेनको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएका छन् ।वगलामुखीको स्थापनाकालबारे स्पष्ट पार्ने कुनै ऐतिहासिक सामग्री प्राप्त भएको छैन । पहिले वगलामुखीको कुनै मन्दिर थिएन, खुल्ला आकाशमुनि नै वगलामुखी स्थापना गरिएको थियो । मन्दिर बन्नुभन्दा अघि नै नेसं १०१५ (सन् १८९५) मा लक्ष्मी नकर्मीले वगलामुखीलाई तामाको चन्द्रमा चढाइएका थिए भने विसं १९५२ (सन् १८९५) मा एक जोडी सिंह चढाइएको थियो । त्यस्तै नेसं १०१८ (सन् १८९८) मा बक्तबारसिंले झण्डा र नेसं १०५० (सन् १९३०) मा व्यषाराज र कुलराजले सिंह स्तम्भ चढाएका थिए । विसं १९८८ (सन् १९३१) मा प्रधानमन्त्री भीमशमशेरले वगलामुखीको लागि मन्दिर निर्माण गरिदिएका थिए । विसं २०६५ (सन् २००९) मा विद्युत शर्टसर्किट भई मन्दिरमा आगो लागेपछि चन्दा उठाएर मर्मत गरिएको थियो ।पहिले मन्दिरको नित्यपूजा कर्माचार्यहरूले गर्थे तर अहिले कुम्भेश्वर मन्दिरका पूजारी राजोपाध्यायले नै नित्यपूजा गरिरहेका छन् । मन्दिरमा जुगी (कपाली) हरू द्य:पा:ला:को रुपमा बस्छन् । प्रत्येक वर्ष मंसीर महिनाको अन्तिम शनिवारको दिनमा वगलामुखी मन्दिरमा पञ्चबलि दिइन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Lakṣmī Kau (Nakarmī) offered a copper moon to Vagalāmukhī.

historical_events.event_name: Offering of a Pair of Lions
historical_events.event_description: Colonel Muktinātha (text: Mugatinātha) Upādhyāya offered a pair of lions to the temple.

historical_events.event_name: Offering of a Pair of Flags
historical_events.event_description: An individual named Guruvācārya Baktabārasĩ and his son Keśava offered a pair of brass flags to the temple.

historical_events.event_name: Installation of a Stone Pillar with a Lion on Top
historical_events.event_description: Vyaṣārāja, Kularāja and their family members installed the stone pillar mounted by a lion statue in front of the Vagalāmukhī Mandira.

historical_events.event_name: Construction of the Present-Day Temple Structure
historical_events.event_description: Previously, there was no temple to house Vagalāmukhī. Prime Minister Bhīma Śamśera constructed the present-day temple to house her. Following the completion of the temple, a hundred and eight goats were sacrificed.
A devotee offered a brass sun to Vagalāmukhī. The name of the person who made the offering is not mentioned in the inscription.

Pātravaṃśa Gaṇeśa Lāla Rāvata from the Pātravaṃśa clan, who is the eldest son of Kṛṣṇa Sundara of Tum Bāhāḥ Ṭola, paved the Vagalāmukhī compound with stone slabs. On that occasion, he also repaired the shrine of the Goddess.

Some devotees of Vagalāmukhī established aguṭhīby collecting donations. Their aim was to buy threeropanīsof land to sponsor the ghee and oil required for the daily worship andbhajanachanting. The names of the donors are inscribed on the pillar.
Harṣarāja and his son Durgārāja offered apatāḥ(banner) to Vagalāmukhī.
Karṇa Bahādura Kārkī, his wife, and other family members from Kupandol offered a metal banner.
Ciḍhīkāji with his wife and other family members, living in Konti Ṭola, offered a metal banner.

historical_events.event_name: Replacing Jhĩgaṭī Roof with Brass Sheets
historical_events.event_description: Śarada Candra Śāhī, Reṇu Śāhī, and other family members replaced thejhĩgaṭīroof with brass sheets.

historical_events.event_name: Repair of the Silver Shrine of Vagalāmukhī
historical_events.event_description: With the financial support of the Department of Archaeology, District Development Committee, Lalitpur, and the devotees, the silver shrine inside the Vagalāmukhī Mandira was renovated. On that occasion, the pinnacle was also gilded. King Vīrendra Vīra Vikrama Śāha unveiled the inscription.
The temple caught on fire in 2009 CE (VS 2065) due to an electric short-circuit.

historical_events.event_name: Formation of a Committee and Renovation of the Temple
historical_events.event_description: Following the fire disaster, a committee was formed to prepare the information report and carry out the restoration work of the temple by raising donations.
